fusions.name: Full-Tilt Line
fusions.desc: You level the staff and drive through a narrow cone 5 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Tap
fusions.desc: A quick rap with the staff in time with your stride that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bruised] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Then you move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Charge Sounded
fusions.desc: You beat the staff on the ground for the charge: your damage rises 25% for 12 seconds and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Quickening Gait
fusions.desc: Every hit you land with the staff builds a hoofbeat stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
